candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall test the effluent for toxicity in accordance with the provisions in this section.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a toxicity-testing monitoring obligation; whether this section applies to a given facility/outfall determines if WET monitoring was required for FY2025.

Scopes which discharge point(s) the toxicity-testing requirements attach to; different readings of outfall numbering or applicability change whether monitoring was required for a given discharge point.

Defines the dilution threshold used in chronic lethal and sub-lethal failure determinations; a different interpretation of the critical dilution value changes whether test outcomes constitute failures and whether follow-on limits or monitoring actions are triggered.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, table (effluent dilution series)
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies the required test concentration series; interpretation affects whether conducted tests satisfy permit testing conditions and whether monitoring evidence is adequate.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, table (test species and methods)
candidates.exact_span:
TEST SPECIES AND METHODS           Ceriodaphnia dubia / Method 1002.0 (EPA-
                                    821-R-02-013 or latest version)
                                    Pimephales promelas/ Method 1000.0
                                    (EPA/821/R-02-013 or latest version)
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies required species and analytical methods; different interpretation of method versions or species applicability changes which monitoring requirements were operative and whether reported tests meet permit conditions.

candidates.exact_span: SAMPLE TYPE                        Defined in PART I
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defers sample-type requirements to PART I; without resolving that cross-reference, whether the correct sample matrix was required and whether missing or atypical results reflect non-requirement versus inadequate evidence remains unresolved.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, item b (NOEC definition)
candidates.exact_span:
The NOEC (No Observed Lethal Effect Concentration) is herein defined as the greatest
      effluent dilution at and below which lethality that is statistically different from the control
      (0% effluent) at the 95% confidence level does not occur.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines how toxicity test outcomes are evaluated; different interpretations of NOEC calculation or statistical significance change whether a test is treated as passing, failing, or requiring further action.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, item b (chronic lethal failure)
candidates.exact_span:
Chronic lethal test failure is
      defined as a demonstration of a statistically significant lethal effect at test completion to a
      test species at or below the critical dilution.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines when a chronic lethal toxicity test fails; interpretation of 'statistically significant,' 'test completion,' or 'at or below the critical dilution' changes failure findings and downstream limit or monitoring consequences.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, item b (chronic sub-lethal failure)
candidates.exact_span:
Chronic sub-lethal test failure is defined as a
      demonstration of a statistically significant sub-lethal effect (i.e., growth or reproduction)
      at test completion to a test species at or below the critical dilution.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines when a chronic sub-lethal toxicity test fails; interpretation of sub-lethal endpoints or significance criteria changes whether results trigger compliance comparisons or additional monitoring obligations.

candidates.exact_span:
This permit may be reopened to require WET limits, chemical specific effluent limits,
      additional testing, and/or other appropriate actions to address toxicity.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Indicates WET numeric limits are not fixed in this excerpt but may be imposed on reopening; interpretation affects whether enforceable numeric discharge limits exist for comparison or only prospective/reporting obligations apply.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, section 2 (test repeat requirement)
candidates.exact_span:
The permittee shall repeat a test, including the control and all effluent dilutions, if the
      procedures and quality assurance requirements defined in the test methods or in this
      permit are not satisfied, including the following additional criteria:
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes when a toxicity test does not satisfy permit requirements and must be repeated; interpretation changes whether absent or deficient results reflect unmet monitoring obligations versus documented non-requirement or unresolved evidence.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, section 2 table (sampling requirement)
candidates.exact_span: Sampling Requirement *             Minimum of 3 samples             Minimum of 3 samples
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets a minimum sampling frequency for toxicity testing; interpretation affects whether monitoring was required at a given frequency and whether fewer reported samples constitute missing required evidence.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, section 2 table (holding time)
candidates.exact_span: Holding time *                     36 hours for first use           36 hours for first use
candidates.computation_change_reason: Limits allowable sample holding time before first use; interpretation affects test validity and whether reported results satisfy monitoring requirements or must be treated as inadequate evidence requiring retest.

candidates.locator: page 8, section part_i, section 2 table (test acceptability criteria)
candidates.exact_span:

candidates.computation_change_reason: Defines minimum control survival for an acceptable test; interpretation determines whether a test must be repeated and whether available results can be used for compliance or missing-evidence classification.

candidates.exact_span:
